analysis_scope: paper-derived shifted_ds adaptation; not the full ERP CORE paper pipeline

paper.target: N170 characterization in Figure 2 and Tables 1–3
paper.limits: 30-scalp average reference, no ICA, .1–30 Hz FIR, no additional onset low-pass; explicit ERPLAB-inspired measurement, not exact MATLAB/software or biological onset equivalence

source.units: microvolts by EEGLAB compatibility convention, not encoded by FDT

reference.operation: ordinary arithmetic mean across all30 channels at each sample, subtracted before filtering
reference.finite_policy: all continuous values of contributing30 channels finite; excluded EOG not a new gate

filter.design: centered sum of individually sized DC-normalized lowpasses: upper minus lower; MNE1.12.1 firwin auto
filter.component_length: round(3.3/((b-a)/2)) then next odd, normalized Nyquist breakpoints
filter.short_segments: retain full kernel, reflect only available samples, no duration exclusion

events.normalize: finite non-Boolean integral number or stripped signed decimal integer string; otherwise no code
events.boundary_duration: removed samples; not a bad recorded interval
events.other_annotations: document only, no implicit BAD-prefix exclusion
events.duplicate_target_samples: all target rows sharing rounded sample excluded; preserve each row

epoch.baseline_operation: per-channel ordinary mean, subtract before trial averaging
epoch.eligibility: whole epoch in recording and one continuous filter segment; no repeated target sample
epoch.rejection: strictly greater than threshold on any of30 contributing channels; equality retained
epoch.ptp_receipts: all geometrically eligible trials including artifact rejects
epoch.average_order: original event row order within subject/condition
epoch.average: ordinary mean of accepted PO8 epochs, equal trial weights

measurement.window_snap: nearest sample; first index on distance tie; inclusive endpoints
measurement.amplitude: signed arithmetic sample mean after measurement-time rebaseline
measurement.peak: strictly below immediate neighbours and both3-sample side means; deepest local, earliest tie; otherwise earliest in-window global minimum
measurement.onset: selected peak must be negative; walk backward to nearest in-window sample at or above halfheight; equality accepted; return sample time
measurement.padding: actual3 samples on each side qualify local peak only, never expand onset window
departures_from_pinned_erplab: earliest equal-depth candidate rather than median position
measurement.source_support: missing condition remains undefined; numerical_zero_difference nulls onset only

precision.accepted_authority: source-close accepted face/car -> one derived/rebased difference -> measurements -> unrounded group; no source-onset scalar gate

group.mean: ordinary unrounded participant mean in canonical subject order
group.ci: sample SD/sqrt(37), Student t df36, two-sided95%
group.missing: per-endpoint complete-cohort null summary; no available-case t36
group.constant: defined constant cohort gives point CI
no_required_outcome: minimum retained trial count beyond1 per defined condition
